layer_chain.interpretation: Both signed gating and multiplicative input sensitivity matter on visited states; leading near-origin quadratic parity is insufficient.
Only transverse branch changes survive to features. Small pre-normalization branch norm amplifies local derivatives; singular matrix values alone do not measure functional step.
Readout gains, head alignment, gate derivatives and all normalization projectors jointly determine J_theta.
The gradient is a score covector, not a torque gradient. Exact same FP32 shapes must underlie likelihood/Fisher/precision comparisons.

layer_chain.law: g_theta=mean[J_theta^T*score*advantage*ratio*active_mask]; active_mask depends on ratio and advantage sign
layer_chain.interpretation: State-only baselines cancel in exact unclipped importance-weighted expectation at any iterate under support/integrability. Finite samples, sign-dependent clipping and action-dependent future critic errors do not give that cancellation automatically.

layer_chain.law: W_next=R(W-eta*D); first-order deltaW=-eta*[D-W*sum(W*D)] with row or column axis matching constraint
layer_chain.interpretation: Ambient momentum/polar preconditioning followed by retraction need not equal tangent preconditioning. Compare independent physical-PG pairing at actual joint Fisher cost, including layer cross terms.
Cross-layer Gram matters. Historical replayed proposals reinforce; actual newarchitecture cross terms remain to be measured. Reinforcement is not proof of usefulness or duplication.
Noise can perturb contact timing and stride velocity, far beyond its direct torque-cost tax. Evaluate sampled, mean and mode closed loops separately.

constraint.interpretation: Near-bound mean requires large precision. Learned head gain removes a fixed small-logit capacity bound; conditioning remains a measurable hypothesis.

optimum_definition.local_policy: conditional first-action finite-H physical return, continuation policy frozen, normalization explicitly held fixed
optimum_definition.natural_direction: u_star=F^-1*g; maximal linear gain at cost c is sqrt(2*c*g^T*F^-1*g)
optimum_definition.model_constraint: project whitened score field onto actual tangent functional Jacobian range; report threshold sensitivity and finite retraction validity
optimum_definition.uncertainty: Use independent-noise signed cross-energy and held-out direction pairing. An arithmetic fit to a noisy field is not proof of useful direction or representation capacity.
optimum_definition.global: Neither local conditional PG nor TD7 reported benchmark establishes a mathematical global optimum.

Raw reward units equal fixed_std times normalized units only in the absence of reward clipping and up to FP32 rounding.
Four noise replicas give conditional Monte Carlo intervals for the fixed selected states; they do not estimate training-seed or state-population uncertainty.
Early/middle episode ages and frozen normalizers restrict generalization to the actual online training occupancy.
A finite-step minus directional-prediction residual mixes curvature, feedback and Monte Carlo noise.

analytical_restart_refinements.normalized_readout_capacity: Nonzero effective affine readout rows remain locally representable through row direction, gain and bias. analytical_restart_refinements.chart_credit: For actual interior alpha,beta, r=log((alpha-1)/(beta-1)), ell=log(alpha+beta-2). Precision-coordinate credit mixes physical mean and log-kappa credit: g_ell=(2*m/kappa)*g_m+(1-2/kappa)*g_logkappa. Actual rounded shapes and candidate softplus-excess coordinates must be distinguished.
analytical_restart_refinements.extrinsic_normal_conversion: Ideal polar and coordinatewise Adam can turn an ambient normal force into a nonzero retracted tangent even when the constrained objective gradient vanishes. This is a verified algebraic possibility, not evidence of actual harmful physical motion. Historical isolated-bank projection changes both gradient and rails and has mixed gain/sqrt(Fisher cost).
analytical_restart_refinements.clipped_baseline: Exact action importance sampling cancels a fixed state baseline at every theta when unclipped. Sign-dependent clipping masks generally break cancellation. Finite empirical baseline noise is separate from population critic bias.
analytical_restart_refinements.objective_alignment: Uniform learner stored-state occupancy, selected first-action finite-horizon forks, and all-time closed-loop propagated discounted occupancy define different covectors. Their pairing signs can disagree with an exact critic; scope, horizon, tail, units, and sampling law must match before attributing differences to critic/optimizer.

analytical_restart_refinements.singular_mode_credit: Selected diagonal lookahead-SVD proposal coefficients are not a complete modal decomposition: lane adaptation introduces offdiagonal and thin-subspace residual motion, and finite mode retractions/Fisher cross terms are nonadditive. Mode current-gradient and subset-surrogate signs do not identify physical credit.
analytical_restart_refinements.sampler_score: Exact ideal clamped-Beta atoms require tail-mass scores, not density scores at clamp endpoints. Diagnostic uniform-quantile truncation and FP32 rounding further change the law. Probability mass alone does not bound directional score bias; observed finite return effects retain their declared-sampler meaning.
analytical_restart_refinements.precision_scope: Actual-step Fisher re-evaluates softplus in FP64 from FP32 logits; distinguish this diagnostic geometry from Fisher algebra on actual rounded FP32 shapes. Candidate actual chart covectors remain unmeasured.
analytical_restart_refinements.direction_dependent_reliability: Fixed actual-update pairing uncertainty depends on v^T C v, whereas whole-field noise depends on trace(C). Exact signed cross-energy variance includes shared-pair dependence. A scalar reliable chord does not justify newly fitted noisy modes; observed-field Cauchy validity does not prove efficiency against unknown mean field.
analytical_restart_refinements.full_gate_credit: Full k(g)=4*tanh(g/4)*sigmoid(g) has unique stationary minimum at -1.2187557268720126 (k=-.2697689954724918), where cap derivative~.912622 but kprime=0. Tangent gate credit is q*kprime(g)*t(u)*(x-w*(w dot x)); up/down can remain active. Visited marginal cap summaries do not identify full gate or useful-credit distributions; no starvation or gate-offset intervention selected.
analytical_restart_refinements.readout_sphere_witness: On the same ideal norm-eight feature great circle, original affine softplus alpha/beta logits cannot maintain constant kappa with nonconstant mean; anchored chart explicit k=1 unit-row/gain construction can, within actual decoder exact-large branch. This proves a fixed-readout-domain family difference, not visited-trunk capacity, superset, optimizer conditioning or causal benefit.
analytical_restart_refinements.readout_gradient_mobility: At fixed features, equal-rate SGD on normalized w, gain rho and bias b induces effective-affine mobility M=rho^2*diag(P_w,1)+[w;b]*[w;b]^T (metric inverse). M=I at rho=+/-1,b=0; later gain/bias change it. Actual independent Adam histories do not implement this M. Nonsingular joint head stationarity implies zero effective-affine covector, unlike body constraints lacking gain routes.
analytical_restart_refinements.action_units: Historical layer audit mean_rms measures native Beta mean on [0,1]; physical torque mean RMS on [-1,1] is exactly twice it. Actual-step script reports physical_mean_motion_rms explicitly. Fisher cost and likelihood pairing are invariant under fixed action rescaling.
